aarti.tek: you are renowned in the three worlds.
aarti.pad1: Moon-faced and seated on a lotus,
you have a radiance that brings blessing.
The auspicious swan you ride adorns you,
and you bear a matchless splendour.
aarti.pad2: In your left hand is the vīṇā,
a jewelled crown graces your head,
and a string of pearls your neck.
aarti.pad3: O Goddess, whoever came to your refuge,
and brought about the destruction of Rāvaṇa.
aarti.pad4: fill us with the light of knowledge.
Rid the world of delusion, ignorance and darkness.
aarti.pad5: Incense, a lamp, fruit and dried fruits:
Give us the eye of knowledge, Mother,
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings Mother Sarasvatī's āratī, which brings good and happiness,
